lines: If you think Allah could never forgive you... this verse is for you.
Allah didn't call them sinners. He called them: O My servants.
O My servants who have transgressed against themselves, do not despair of the mercy of Allah.
Indeed, Allah forgives all sins. All. Not some.
Then He says: Return to your Lord.
Say أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ... and come back today. Send this to someone who needs it, and watch our full movies, link below.

beats.ur: سوچتے ہیں اللہ آپ کو کبھی معاف نہیں کرے گا؟ یہ آیت آپ کے لیے ہے

beats.en: O My servants who have transgressed against themselves [by sinning], do not despair of the mercy of Allah
And return [in repentance] to your Lord

beats.text: Say *أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ* and come back today. Send this to someone who needs it.
beats.ur: آج ہی استغفار کریں اور لوٹ آئیں۔ یہ اس تک پہنچائیں جسے اس کی ضرورت ہے

scenes.style: High-quality 3D animated feature film still, close to photoreal (modern big-studio animation look), rich detail, cinematic lighting and depth of field. Vertical 9:16, keep the top third fairly simple and dark-to-plain (text sits there), the action in the lower two thirds. Symbolic scenes of light after darkness. ABSOLUTELY NO PEOPLE, no human figures, no silhouettes anywhere.

scenes.s1: A dark stormy night sky over a calm sea, a single bright beam of light breaking through the heavy clouds onto the water.
scenes.s2: A heavy wooden door in a dark stone street, slightly open, warm golden light pouring out onto the stones.
scenes.s3: Dawn light flooding a quiet desert valley after a dark night, the first rays touching the sand and rocks, birds rising.
scenes.s4: A golden sunrise over a calm sea, the whole sky glowing, gentle waves sparkling with light.
scenes.s5: A path through green fields after rain leading toward a bright sunrise, drops shining on the grass.
scenes.s6: An oil lamp burning brightly on a simple wooden table by an open window at sunrise, a prayer rug folded beside it, peaceful light.
